Qualified students, parents, and educators still have several weeks to take advantage of Apple's 2026 back-to-school promotion on select Mac and iPad models. Here's what you need to know.

Apple's 2026 back-to-school promotion has been extended through September 24

Apple has updated the promotional period for its 2026 back-to-school deal, as spotted by MacRumors. The offer, originally set to run from July 16 through August 27, now ends on September 24.

This year, in addition to the standard education pricing discounts on Mac and iPad, eligible students who purchase a qualifying Mac or iPad can also receive an Apple gift card valued at up to $150.

Below is the official table from Apple showing the gift card amount included with each qualifying Mac and iPad purchase:

Product Category Eligible Products Promotion Product Mac MacBook Pro $150 Apple Gift Card Mac MacBook Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Pro $100 Apple Gift Card

Per the terms and conditions of the "2026 College Student Promotion":

Eligible participants in this promotion include faculty, staff, students, and parents (collectively referred to as "Qualifying Purchasers"), as follows: K–12 – Includes staff of public and private K–12 institutions in the United States, as well as homeschool teachers, all of whom are eligible. Additionally, current elected or appointed members of school boards are eligible. Current elected or appointed officers of a parent-teacher association (PTA or PTO) executive committee are also eligible. Higher Education – Faculty teaching at U.S. higher education institutions, as well as students currently enrolled or admitted, are eligible. Parents of Higher Education Students – Parents purchasing on behalf of their children, provided the child is currently enrolled or admitted at a public or private U.S. higher education institution, are eligible. Personal purchases made through the Apple Education Store are not eligible for institutional purchases or resale purposes.

If you don't qualify, or you're seeing this after the promotion has ended, you can still find discounts on Macs and iPads through Apple's official Amazon storefront that beat the standard Apple education pricing.

You can also save up to 15% on a wide variety of products through the Apple Certified Refurbished store.
